# @paladini/lattes-toolkit

Toolkit to read and write Currículo Lattes fields in exported XML, from code, the CLI, or an AI agent. You export the XML on Plataforma Lattes, edit fields locally, and import the file back. Not affiliated with CNPq.

Docs: https://paladini.github.io/lattes-toolkit/
npm install @paladini/lattes-toolkit
